name: Bass Drop Arena
promptTemplate: Stage view festival arena with {{beam_style}} spotlight sweeps, {{glow_intensity}} glow intensity, {{atmosphere}} haze, {{strobe_palette}} strobes, crowd density {{stagedepth}}, and sync {{bounce_sync}}

ui.title: BASS ARENA +6
ui.tagline: Rave pit controller & live drop trigger

glow_intensity.hint: Amplifies laser beam strength and haze bloom

strobe_palette.hint: Sets the flash tint when the bass drops

stagedepth.hint: Packs deeper silhouette rows into the back crowd

bounce_sync.hint: Locks silhouettes to the live bass pulse

drop_bass.hint: Hits full strobe flash and sets the arena jumping

listing.blurb: Sweeping laser cones illuminate a packed crowd waving personal glowsticks while the room detonates bass drops and strobes on cue.
listing.prompt: A festival crowd seen from the stage: silhouettes of people waving glowsticks in their own colours, one figure per person in the room, spotlights sweeping; anyone can drop the bass, making the lights strobe and the crowd jump. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
